SELECT IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.today_all),0) AS allNum,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.ai_num),0) AS AINum, IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.manual_num),0) AS manNum,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.onekey_num),0) AS keyNum FROM vm_statistics_event_num_day dataTable WHERE 1=1 ${dataScope}
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),interval 1 DAY) ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m-%d')

#{typeId}

SELECT sum(order_num) as orderNum,warning_source as warningSource FROM vm_statistics_event_source dataTable WHERE 1=1 ${dataScope}
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),interval 1 DAY) ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m-%d')
group by warning_source
